summary: Patterson-UTI Energy filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to its existing credit agreement. The amendment extends the maturity date for $450 million of revolving credit commitments from January 31, 2030 to January 31, 2031, and assigns $25 million of commitments from HSBC to JPMorgan. No tender offer, merger, restructuring, or special situation is involved. This is a standard refinancing/administrative action, not a special situation event.
